name: Serenity 티커 알림
tagline: Watches one trader's X feed and pings you privately when a ticker call lands
description: Every quarter of an hour it re-reads a nominated X account through a public mirror and pulls out any fresh entry, add-on or long position mentioned against a ticker symbol. Whatever it finds is repeated back inside your own chat and nowhere else, without spending X API quota. It relays, it does not recommend.
author: krong
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
